newsitem.title: USA: Camco, First Ashland say holders ok merger.
newsitem.headline: Camco, First Ashland say holders ok merger.

text.p: Camco Financial Corp and First Ashland Financial Corp said on Thursday their shareholders have approved the merger agreement announced in March.
First Ashland is the parent of First Federal Bank for Savings of Ashland, Kentucky.
Camco said its shareholders have also approved an increase in its authorized shares from 2.6 million to five million, consisting of 4.9 million common shares and 100,000 preferred shares.
The companies said that as previously announced, First Ashland will merge into Camco, and First Federal Bank for Savings will continue operations as a stand-alone subsidiary of Camco.
Camco said it expects regulatory approval within the week, and sees the transaction closing in early October.
